description: MANAGEMENT data class. Discover persisted allocation runs and their separate cost-centre and profit-centre reconciliations; do not add them together. This does not generate or recompute allocation. Money is decimal-string rupees. Choose one allocation_dimension in a detail read. Results are ordered period, version, then run id, and the signed page_token is pinned to the complete filtered source: if it reports source_changed, restart at page 1. current_only means latest generated version, not source freshness; known_stale and not_assessed are both warnings, never a claim that the source is fresh. Raw stale reasons and warning context are not returned.

current_only.description: Return only the latest generated version per period (default true); this is not a freshness claim.

page_token.description: Signed continuation from the prior page; restart without it if source_changed.

name: list_allocation_runs
title: List allocation runs
